title: Electricity: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Electric storage and draw use internal charge units; Generator Output is internal charge per simulated second. Battery Charge reads a 0 to 1 fraction and electric port inspection shows the EMP-adjusted supply fraction, both without a unit. A conversion of internal charge to joules or watts was not recovered.

Shaft speed is RPS, and a simple shaft group mixes speeds weighted by force_emitter_max_force plus weight 1 for the group's previous speed. How arbitrary gearbox and clutch networks, conflicting ratio loops and connector rebuilds combine groups was not decoded, and the model gives no SI torque or inertia.

Component updates run 60 times per simulated second, so 60 × the charge per update is the charge per simulated second, in internal units. Generator Output already includes that factor. The shaft solver weights speed changes by force_emitter_max_force and has no torque or inertia in SI units, so it gives no charge-per-joule figure for mechanical work. The shipped realtime file sets electric_consumption_scale to 0.01, but the executable contains that name neither as ASCII nor as UTF-16LE text, and its effect was not recovered.

title: Fluids: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Native coverage for this build: ordinary and enclosed pipe networks, fixed liquid and gas tanks, the electric, impeller, modular and manual pumps, both filters, the old Hose and mechanical winches, rope-hook hoses, hose pulleys and the fluid connector. Custom-compartment volume from wall geometry and hull flooding were not decoded. Diesel and jet-fuel tank startup, startup from saved inventory, handheld hose free ends, slurry processing and steam or seawater behaviour outside the selected phase-change callers were not traced. The four realtime fluid damping names do not occur in the executable, so their effect on this build was not recovered.

The shipped realtime file lists gas and liquid base damping 0.99 and 0.9999, but none of the four fluid damping names occurs in the executable, so no setting binding was recovered. To test for an effect, compare two values of a setting on the same layout and starting inventory. Check Flow Rate against the solver bounds on the actual network graph: pipe length adds no volume, and hoses and connectors link networks at factor 1 or 0.5. Check a prefab gas tank's start (59.4 atm decoded) separately from a fluid-spawner compartment (60 atm in its tooltip).

title: Other components: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Not decoded: how the body-mass producer's redistribution, clamping and linked bodies, and fuel, cargo or damage, change the signature S, and how S compares with the editor's mass total; which collision bits terrain, water, glass and vehicles register with, and so which of them block the line-of-sight query; the height sampler 0x1402bc7d0 behind the legacy height gates; what else can set a legacy sensor's saved radar_fov; what the legacy Signal Strength output carries; the laser missile radar (radar_type 2) acquisition path; advanced sonar submersion gating and the noisemaker's effect on the sonar. For radios: what the two global flags in the directional gate 0x1402645f0 mean and when they are set (while either is clear a directional antenna's gain is 0); how the legacy radios' separate send and receive frequencies and their data use the receive routine, whose legacy records carry one frequency and no payload flags; payload and audio effects of a weak signal beyond the clamp(2 × S) level; the exact rounding of the native power routine in the height term. None of the radio figures was checked in a running game.

title: Propulsion: decode remaining behavior and formulas

title: Transmission: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: SI torque, inertia and physical power losses are unknown: the bridge is a weighted speed exchange in solver units, and no conversion to newton-metres or watts was recovered. No finite slip torque or friction law was recovered.

Where torque_gearbox_2's tooltip limit of 4000 torque difference is enforced, and in what unit, was not located. The gearbox update, ratio helper and traced shaft solve hold no 4000 and compare the copied force_emitter_max_force with nothing; a computed or indirect check elsewhere, or obsolete tooltip text, remains possible.
Damage disconnects the bridge, but the events that set or clear a gearbox's or clutch's damage, including any torque-triggered breakage, were not traced.
The bridge equations are decoded for two groups joined by one bridge. Arbitrary loops, both ports on one group and graph rebuild order were not decoded.

title: Impeller Pump: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Static analysis of one build; the flow figures are equal-pressure bounds, not measured flow. The shaft load unit was not established.

The impeller reads the speed of the shaft on its RPS port and pushes with bias 4 × |RPS| × pump_pressure. Spinning the shaft backward pushes the same way. Unlike the electric pumps it is two-way: backpressure can push fluid back through it, and at low flow it exchanges temperature between its two networks. The shaft port records a load request of 0.1 × pump_pressure; its torque unit was not established.
Torque, speed, fuel use and efficiency curves are unknown. Internal configuration fields are not measured force, torque, watts or joules.
Fluid In, RPS and Fluid Out have no descriptions beyond their labels. The pressure-flow relation and the units of pump_pressure are unknown.

title: Gravity, damping and friction: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: The world, solver, timestep, damping and friction figures come from those native decodes. Still not recovered: the solver's normal and tangent impulse iterations, its friction-row bounds, collision-shape coverage and restitution threshold, and the rule by which mass redistribution rewrites a vehicle's gravity.
